name: LongReason
description: LongReason is a synthetic benchmark designed to evaluate long-context reasoning abilities of large language models by synthesizing long-context reasoning questions from short-context ones, covering reading comprehension, logical inference, and mathematical word problems.
reputation: A recent synthetic benchmark for long-context reasoning that is useful for controlled evaluation, but it has not yet become a widely established standard.
notes: Focuses on long-context reasoning evaluation with diverse reasoning patterns; open-sourced for community use.
